page.overview:
Who is Bioluminescent Ankylosaurus?

The bioluminescent Ankylosaurus is a genetically modified hybrid of Ankylosaurus and cuttlefish that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A bioluminescent variant of the Ankylosaurus can be created in Minecraft Jurassic World.
